items.note: The prompt says: "Exports can reach about 2 million rows, so memory use matters."
The prompt says to keep the signature `export_orders_csv(db, path)`. It doesn't give the reason (three callers), but the requirement itself is there.
The prompt requires the exact header and column order: `id,customer_name,total,created_at`.
The prompt says: "Add no new dependencies."
The prompt names the N+1 lookup as the known main cause: one `query_one` per order row.
The prompt says to write each row to the file as it is produced instead of building one big string.
The prompt says customer names can contain commas and every value must be written with proper CSV quoting.
The prompt says to run the existing tests in tests/test_export.py and report the command and its result.
The prompt says: "Change size: minimal... do not restructure the module."
